title: AcaTime production validation evidence
description: Aggregate, privacy-preserving evidence and sanitized logs for 17 faculty-scale AcaTime GA validation runs: scores, improvement percentages, durations and checksums. Raw institutional data and schedules are not included. The representative 199,180 -> 256,450 API run is not part of this release.

creators.name: Miroshnykov, Daniil
creators.affiliation: Taras Shevchenko National University of Kyiv, Faculty of Computer Science and Cybernetics

notes: Aggregate-only v0.1: 17 validation runs, sanitized logs. Raw faculty data and the separate representative API run are not included.
